question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**way**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, **the blank 1 refers to a manner in which the subject know the environment. **
 
• **"Way" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**
 
• "Way" refers to a method, manner, or route.(तरीका)
 
 
• Example: "Can you show me the way to the nearest gas station?"
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "line", refers to a long, narrow mark or band.(रेखा)
 
• Option 3, "time", refers to the indefinite continued progress of existence and events in the past, present, and future.(समय)
 
• Option 4, "style", refers to a particular manner or way of doing something. (शैली)
